signal: Symetri acquired the Autodesk division of Repro Products and SolidCAD in 2025, adding hundreds of AECO clients across the Americas

email.body1:
Chris, saw Symetri folded in Repro Products' Autodesk division and SolidCAD, adding hundreds of AECO clients across the Americas.

A run of acquisitions like that usually means more strategic accounts than the team can personally cover before the integrations settle. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Symetri off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for Symetri.

After back-to-back acquisitions, the strategic account base expands faster than coverage can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to work the new logos, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your AECO strategic accounts need, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for Symetri.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Symetri's reply rate likely compares to other technology solution providers. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority while the acquisitions integrate, no problem at all. Folding in new teams is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic-accounts motion? I'll tailor it to Symetri either way.
